reasoning_traces.think:
We formulate a hierarchical Bayesian multinomial model to estimate the probability distribution of plate appearance outcomes (hit, walk, strikeout, etc.) given the time-through-order (TTO) stage. The model incorporates random intercepts for each batter-pitcher matchup to account for unobserved heterogeneity. By integrating over the posterior distribution of model parameters, we obtain posterior predictive distributions for wOBA at different TTO stages. Our key finding—that the TTOP is not a sharp discontinuity but a gradual trend—arises from the shrinkage properties of the hierarchical prior, which pools information across matchups and reduces variance. This approach provides a coherent uncertainty quantification framework that contrasts with frequentist point estimates.
